name: go-grpc
description: > gRPC services in Go beyond the basics: proto design, status codes and error details, interceptors, deadlines, streaming, health checks, and graceful shutdown. Use when: "gRPC service", "proto design", "gRPC error handling", "interceptor", "gRPC streaming", "gRPC deadline", "grpc health check", "gRPC status codes". Not for: REST handlers (go-api-design), protobuf-agnostic layering (go-architecture-review), TLS hardening (go-security-audit).
author: eduardo-sl
summary_zh: 面向 Go 的 gRPC 服务开发指南，适合处理协议设计、错误码、拦截器、流式通信、超时、健康检查与优雅停机场景。
